text: Heyyy.
Hullo hall.
Well look who stumbled in, Borin, sit before I forget your face.
Oh look, Ingrid stumbled in, evening to her before I forget faces.
Oh it's you. I was just telling the barrel about you.
Mornin to Halvar, if it is still morning, I lost count after three ales.
Hey hey, whole hall, I brought thirst and leftover dignity.
Hullo, Alvis.
Good to see you can hold a mug, outsider, even Sindri would clap.
Wait wait, greetings to Brokk, I started that sentence down in the mine.
There you are, Frida, I thought the door ate you.
Howdy to Tova by the forge, if that is still a word people say.
Welcome back, I saved you a seat that keeps spinning.
Look who.
Look what the night dragged in, and I mean that kindly, Hrolf.
Evening all, try not to look so sober, it makes me nervous.
Hey, that's Yngvar, yeah him, the one not swaying yet by the gate.
Greetings to Runa I think, unless I already said that in the hall.
Oh hey, the clan's still awake, lucky me.
Tell Steinar I'm off before the floor picks a fight with my boots.
Night, all.
Bye, Dagna, save a sip, I'll forget why I left.
I'm going home, or toward home, one of those.
Farewell to Kolbrun, don't wait up, I walk in circles toward the mine.
See you when the room stops moving.
G'night, Steinar, don't let the spiders lecture you.
I'm done, folks, the mug won and I am leaving with honor.
S'bye.
I'm heading out, Orm can keep my stool, I forget why I sat.
Good night, I think I still know where my bed is.
Off I go, wait, which door was the door.
Later, Runa, if later still exists tomorrow.
I'm stumbling home, I think I promised Brokk I'd stay upright.
Farewell, hall, you were loud and I loved you for it.
Catch Dvalin after I sleep this off, whenever the mine bell rings.
Going, going, still going, alright I'm actually going.
Night, Vidar, keep the ale honest while I'm gone.
That's me done, everybody, try to stay standing.
I could murder a pie right now, not a person, a pie.
Sky's doing that orange thing again, or maybe that's Eitri's ale talking.
I've had four, or fourteen, the numbers got slippery.
Bread's chewy tonight, like it wants an argument.
The mine smelled like wet coins today, I kind of liked it.
Quiet night.
Funny thing, my left boot feels wiser than my right.
Hall's spinning, but Vidar says spinning is just walking in place.
Weather's soft, good for sitting, bad for remembering Ingrid's chores.
You ever notice Orm's beard looks like it has opinions.
Same old anvil noise, kinda comforting when the room tilts.
I could eat a whole boar, tusks, stubbornness, everything.
My head is a drum and somebody keeps playing it.
Ale's warmer than my thoughts, that's a compliment, don't tell Halvar.
Farm's doing fine I hear, or I dreamed that, hard to say.
Gold's pretty until you try to count it, I should hide this from Runa.
Work can wait, sitting cannot, that's my philosophy tonight.
Clan songs get better when you forget half the words.
Spiders got no sense of tavern hours, Orm would sleep through them anyway.
Goblin trader smiled too much, I don't trust extra teeth.
Axes just sit there judging you, mine keeps looking like Steinar.
Home's that way, unless it moved again.
I forget what I was saying about Skadi's stew, which is usually the best part.
Floor's friendly tonight, keeps coming up to say hello.
So then?
Where did I put my mug, it was just in my hand, I swear.
Is the forge still hot or am I imagining Eitri's heat again.
Who's paying, and don't all look at the ceiling.
Is the room tilting or am I doing that myself.
Did anyone see Skadi, she walked that way, or that way.
What's that noise from below, ore or trouble, sounds like Kolbrun.
You still owe me for that axe, Torvi, or did the ale eat the debt.
How many pints is too many, asking for this body.
Where'd the goblin wander off with my coin.
Anybody else hungry, or is that just my stomach making speeches.
Why is Halvar always late when the stew is actually good.
What was I drinking, asking myself, Tova would know and I forgot.
Creeper or a very ugly shadow, Frida, I need a second opinion.
Who took the last loaf, and be brave about it.
When did the gate start squeaking like that, I blame Alvis in my head.
Is Gudrun coming to sit, or is she gonna hover like a moth at trade.
Did the clan vote on something, I blinked and missed a year.
Where's my pickaxe, I set it down beside a thought.
Are we trading tonight or just staring at the goods.
Why's the human smiling, do we owe him or does he owe us.
Pour me another, just one, I mean it this time, probably.
Could you fetch my pick, Eitri, I left it near something hot.
Give us a hand with this ore, Vidar, it got heavier after supper, I swear.
Mind grabbing bread, Tova, my stomach is writing complaints.
Lean me on that wall, Ragna, just till my knees remember work.
Somebody get water, I may have outrun my own good sense.
Sharpen this later, Brynja, no rush, the axe can wait, I cannot stand.
Walk me home, Gudrun, my feet are holding a meeting without me.
Cover my shift tomorrow, Dvalin, I will invent a noble reason.
Pass the mead down, if it hasn't grown legs.
Ask Brynja to save me a seat, the good one that doesn't spin.
Tell Brokk I need that hammer back, politely, then less politely.
Can the hall keep it down, I'm trying to hear my own story.
Swap me a loaf for this shiny bit, Alvis, fair enough.
Point me at the gate, I keep finding the kitchen instead.
Hold my mug a second, wait, give it back, I regret that.
Ask Ingrid if the stew's safe, she knows things.
Lend me a cloak, night air is picking fights.
Get the clan a round, I'll pay when my pockets wake up.
Help me find Kolbrun, he owes the table a song.
Scoot over.
Everyone to the gate, now, and try to walk in one direction.
Grab an axe and get moving, spiders don't wait for last calls.
Fill the mug, Kolbrun, before I start making speeches.
Stoke that fire, Brokk, it died while I was blinking, heroic work.
Sit me down before I become furniture the hard way.
Get the goblin out, I don't like how he counts.
Bring more ale, Dagna, and don't you dare look stingy, I'm fragile.
Lock the gate, Halvar, I heard a noise that wasn't us.
Quit whining, Yngvar, and pick up the tool.
Everybody shut it a minute, I almost had a thought.
Put the gold down, Skadi, we look with eyes first.
Take the watch, Steinar, I'm better at sitting than seeing straight.
Leave the last pie, that pie has a destiny and it is mine.
March, clan, the farm won't guard itself.
Stop poking the forge, Eitri, it pokes back hotter.
Clear the table, songs need room and so do elbows.
Hold the line at the door, zombies have no manners.
Drink slower, all of you, we are not racing the barrel tonight.
Here, take my seat, I wasn't using it right anyway, Steinar.
Want a swig, Ingrid, I have more courage than sense tonight.
I'll sharpen that for a drink after, Yngvar, that's a fair foggy deal.
Stay at my place, Hrolf, roof leaks but it leaks warmly.
I'll trade this gold bit for that bread, Torvi, no tricks, probably.
Have some bread, Frida, you look emptier than my second mug.
I'll walk your mine shift, Halvar, you look done, I look horizontal.
Give Alvis the cloak, it's colder out than my stories by the farm.
I can watch the gate if watching includes leaning.
Let me carry the ore, Dvalin, I need the weight to stay on the ground.
I'll talk to the goblin, Borin, he can't cheat a man already confused.
Share my stew, Tova, I poured extra on purpose, or by accident.
I could fetch your axe, if I remember what an axe looks like.
Take my last coin, Ingrid, clan first, pockets second.
I'll sing so you don't have to, that's a gift and a warning.
Come use the forge, Brokk, I'll keep the sparks from my beard, maybe.
I can hide your treasure under my bench, Runa, nobody looks there.
You first then.
Have some.
Cheers pal.
That pour was art, Gudrun, I could weep, I might anyway.
Sindri's the best smith we have, even my blurry eyes know it.
Fine mining today, Skadi, best shine I've seen since last week, and I saw two of it.
Torvi's the toughest in this clan, don't argue, I'll fall over.
Lucky we have you, Ragna, lucky lucky, I said it twice so it's true.
Dagna found more gold than the rest of us put together, wild.
You worked that shift quiet, Orm, I respect quiet, I can't do it.
Vidar dropped that zombie alone, braver than my knees.
Brynja, you're ugly as a wet goat and that's why I trust you.
Torvi's warning about the creeper saved me more than another sip would.
You kept the gate, Kolbrun, whole clan owes you a song and a chair.
That axe sings, Steinar, or I'm hearing things, either way I'm impressed.
Well done, all of you, I noticed through the ale, that's saying something.
Frida's stew could raise the dead, in a kind way.
Solid graft.
Kind mug.
Grimhild keeps the books honest, rare as a full mug.
Good trade, Gudrun, I almost understood the numbers.
Frida dances like a sober person, which is a talent I lack at work.
I sloshed, Runa.
Ate the last bread, didn't think, I'll owe Frida a supper in the morning.
Didn't mean to lean on Hrolf, he was just conveniently shaped near the forge.
I spilled on the ledger, Grimhild, I'll dry it with dignity.
Sorry I called Ragna a barrel, she's handsomer than the beer barrels.
My fault the song died, I forgot the middle and the end.
Forgive the volume, the hall asked for a whisper and I missed.
I took your stool, Borin, I thought it was following me.
Sorry about that ore cart, I keep replaying Dvalin jumping aside.
Sorry I scared the outsider hugging the door, tell Ingrid I meant warmth.
I drank somebody's pour, thought it was mine, they all look related, even Skadi's.
Excuse the wobble, I'm conducting an experiment with gravity.
Sorry clan, I said I'd stand watch and then I sat watch.
I broke a plate, it started it, I'm still sorry, Brynja would scold the plate too.
Forgive me, Skadi, I told your secret to a very quiet mug.
My mistake on the trade, I counted fingers instead of coin, like Vidar said.
Didn't mean to yell at the forge, it just looked smug.
Sorry I missed the vote, I was busy losing an argument with stew.
You fight like a sleepy goat, Hrolf, and the goat would apologize.
Nice brain, shame it clocked out before supper.
He's crazy, the fun kind until he touches the gold.
You swing that tankard like it insulted your mother, Borin.
Brilliant work, if we were judging puddles.
Sindri cheats at looking innocent, look at that face.
You call that an axe, Grimhild, I've seen sharper bread and nicer crumbs.
The goblin has more spine than you, and he's selling junk.
Walk straight, Grimhild looks like a cart with one idea and no axe.
Your stew tastes like a wet sock with ambition, Gudrun.
She's all talk and no ore, Dvalin said it quieter than I will.
You mine like the rock is doing you a favor, Dvalin.
What a hero, hid behind a mug when the spider waved.
Your clan pride is loud, your work is a whisper.
Sindri stands like a question mark that gave up on the ore.
That forge work is modern art, meaning I don't get it and I'm mad.
Brokk's jokes are older than the gate and twice as rusty.
You trade like your pockets have holes and opinions.
He's about as useful as a chocolate pickaxe, and twice as messy.
What a puddle.
It would be a shame if your forge caught a little accident, Eitri, just thinking.
Touch that mug again and we are having a short friendship.
Careful, or you'll end up in the lava, and I will narrate it.
Take one more step toward my gold and I stand up, maybe.
Keep poking the clan and I'll remember how fists work.
Steal from this hall and I'll find you, eventually, after a nap.
Smile at my bread like that again and we have a problem.
I'll sit on Borin, I'm heavy and motivated about that trade debt.
Next time you cheat the trade, I break the scale on your head.
Leave Runa's axe or I start charging interest in bruises.
Talk about my kin like that and the table learns to fly.
Come near the kids with that look and I forget I'm friendly.
Spill my ale on purpose and we settle it in the yard.
I could end Dagna's evening, politely, with a door at the forge.
Keep following me home and the hallway gets narrower for you.
One more lie about the ore and I introduce you to the anvil.
Try me.
Watch yer tilt.
Careful, the lava is close, Alvis, closer than my common sense, hop.
Behind you, a creeper, I'm not joking this time, run.
Watch the gate, something out there doesn't like songs.
Hot coals, Gudrun, your boots are braver than your feet.
Mind the cart, Kolbrun, it's rolling like it has a grudge.
Spider on the beam, Brynja, don't look up too fast, you'll tip.
That stew's still boiling, it'll bite you first.
Floor's slick by the kegs, I learned the hard horizontal way.
Zombie's at the fence, tell the ones who can still jog.
Don't trust that smile from the trader, it has extra corners.
Pickaxe is cracked, it'll leave you mid swing.
Storm's coming over the farm, bring the goats or the bread, both.
Quiet, I hear digging that isn't ours.
Stay off the east shaft, it coughed dust at me like a warning.
Creeper, folks!
Watch out.
Where did my ore go, Brokk.
Don't trust Sindri, he cheats at dice and at faces.
You drank the round I paid for, Ragna, I counted, badly, but I counted.
She left the gate open, I saw the draft, I felt betrayal.
You hid the last pie behind a story, Skadi, very clever, I know that trick.
Halvar took the good hammer and left me a sad one.
That missing coin has your walk, Sindri, don't make it worse.
You told the clan I slept through watch, Yngvar, which is rude because it's true.
Who emptied my keg, and why do you look so refreshed, Eitri.
You sold my axe to the goblin, Grimhild, I can smell the deal on you.
Dvalin left the supports loose, that's why the drip found my neck.
Halvar blamed the human for his own mess, I was there, blurry but there.
Ragna pocketed a gem, her pocket jingled like guilt.
Yngvar started that fight then hid in a song, I noticed by the gate.
The books are short, Grimhild, and my math is drunk not stupid.
You let the spider in because you wanted a story, admit it.
Somebody here told my secret, and you're sweating, so hello.
Evenin then.
Welcome.
Mornin then.
There, Alvis.
Heya.
Come in.
Look who's here.
Listen, no listen, hello Alvis, I found the door on the third try.
Well if it isn't Brynja, I was just inventing a toast for you.
Hail, clan, I brought a thirst and a rumor I already forgot.
Oh good, Steinar's face, I was worried I'd imagined you.
Greetings, Vidar, wipe your boots or don't, I already can't tell.
Hey, Tova, the stool next to me is only slightly haunted.
Evening, all you blurry people, I like you anyway.
There you are, I lost you behind a mug, Kolbrun.
Welcome home, Brynja, the hall still knows your walk.
Hi again, Dagna, I think we did this already, do it again.
Oh it's the trader's least favorite customer, meaning us, hello.
Park yourself, Vidar, before I start greeting the furniture.
Catch ya later.
Wobblin homeward.
G'night.
See ya.
Snooze soft.
I'm wobblin off.
Don't wait.
Night, Borin.
Anyway, tell Borin I'm leaving before the bench claims me as clan.
Farewell, Frida, hide the good ale from my future self.
I'm off to find my bed, it owes me an apology.
Bye, hall, keep the spiders out of my song.
That's enough night for me, clan, try not to vote till I wake.
Heading home sideways, wish the walls luck, and Yngvar if he's a wall.
Goodbye for Steinar, don't follow him, I don't know the way home either.
See you at the forge, Eitri, or in a dream, same temperature.
I'm out, Yngvar, if I fall, pretend it was a bow.
Night all you singers, save a verse that makes sense.
Leaving now, the mug and I have reached an understanding.
Another pint.
Hic.
Warm ale.
Soft rain.
Loud hall.
Tasty stew.
Heavy ore.
Old song.
Tired feet.
Warm loaf.
The thing is, gold looks louder after the fourth mug, I'll tell Grimhild later.
Anyway, Orm's pickaxe has a nicer singing voice than he does.
I swear the anvil winked at me, or I winked first.
Between me and the bench, the farm bread has been showing off, Sindri knows.
You know what, spiders have worse table manners than Yngvar.
Torvi, now where was I, right, the gate squeaks in a lonely key.
Funny, I just remembered a joke about Sindri and lost it in the mine.
Don't mind me, I'm interviewing this mug about its childhood.
And another thing, axes deserve names, this one is probably stubborn, like Ragna.
Mm, the forge smells like decisions I will regret tomorrow.
Halvar, see, the trouble is, treasure doesn't hug you back.
Alvis talks to ore like it owes him rent, I respect that.
Who's that.
Brokk, you there?
Why not.
What now.
Where's Orm.
How much.
You coming.
Listen, did Ingrid hide the good keg again or am I imagining empty.
So I says, wait, Brokk, I meant to ask where the crossbow wandered off to.
Is Halvar still arguing with that goblin, or did the goblin win.
Who left a zombie compliment on the fence, it looked personal.
When did Steinar start polishing gold like it's a baby.
Are we working tomorrow or is tomorrow a rumor.
Why does Brynja's axe get a better seat than I do.
Has anyone priced the trader's junk, besides my leftover dignity.
What happened to the clan horn, it was here, then it was a dream.
Is the bread supposed to crunch like gravel, Dagna, asking for my teeth.
Did Runa really beat a spider with a ladle, or is that the ale talking.
Which way is the mine, Dvalin, I keep arriving at supper.
Do we trust that human with the shiny bag, I don't, but I'm polite.
Ale please.
Pass it.
Help me.
One more.
Sit closer.
Bread please.
Could you wake Dagna before the forge goes cold, gently, then louder.
Fetch my shield, Torvi, I set it down next to a very convincing thought.
Ask Brokk where the gem box went, and do not accept a shrug.
Pour for the table, the clan looks thirsty and I look like proof.
Mind holding this gold, Ingrid, my hands are doing a little dance.
Point me at work, any work, Halvar, before I invent a new hobby.
Find Skadi, the stew needs her, or I need her, same direction.
Trade me that pick for this sad story and a coin, Brokk.
Fetch everybody a loaf, I'll remember to pay in the morning, maybe.
Help Tova with the goats if the goats haven't unionized.
Lend me your ears, and also your spare helmet.
Would you check the east tunnel, I heard a polite growl.
Save me a spot by the anvil, the warm one, not the judgmental one.
Tell the outsider to stop poking the relics, nicely, then with a look.
Sit down.
Drink up.
Hold on.
Lock it.
Stand up.
Drop the shiny.
C'mere a sec.
Give it room.
Everybody grab a weapon, the fence is having company.
Put that gold back, Sindri, I can hear it jingling guilty.
Stoke the forge, Frida, before my courage cools with it.
Into the mine, you lot, ore doesn't walk itself home.
Leave the last sausage, I have claimed it in a loud whisper.
March to the gate, clan, and try to count to two in a straight line.
Stop haggling, the goblin's already won if you're still talking.
Hold the children inside, spiders are taking the long way around.
Clear the slag, Halvar, before somebody skates on it.
Take watch, Alvis, I'm better at sitting than seeing.
Drink water first, all of you, then we can be foolish on purpose.
Yours now.
My seat.
Yeah I will.
Let me.
This one's yours.
I can finish the watch if finishing includes humming.
Give me Brynja's ore, she already carried my dignity.
I'll trade you a song for that heel of bread, almost fair.
Use my spare pick, it only bites on Tuesdays.
I could stand between you and that trader, I'm wide and confusing.
Sleep by my fire, the leaks have rhythm.
I'll sharpen Gudrun's blade, she sharpened my last three excuses.
Have a sip, stranger, it's braver than I am.
The clan chest can live under my cloak, nobody looks there twice.
Let me talk to Hrolf, he listens when the words arrive sideways.
I'll take the spider shift, they like me, or they like moving targets.
Share this stew, I made enough for a small army or one of me.
I will walk you to the gate, assuming the gate stays put.
Keep this coin, work first, my thirst can write a promise.
Fine axe.
Shiny haul.
Brave work.
Best smith.
Not bad that.
Kolbrun's bread could end a feud, or start a better one.
You kept the mine from coughing, that's real work, Eitri.
Skadi's aim is cleaner than my conscience, which is a low bar, still.
That trade was almost honest, I nearly stood up to clap.
Torvi stood the watch like a door that learned pride.
Ingrid's stew made the hall go quiet, a miracle and a kindness.
You, human, didn't flinch at the anvil, I like that kind of stubborn.
Yngvar hauled more ore than my stories hauled me, respect.
Runa's joke landed, I think, I laughed in the right place.
Good forge work, the metal actually looks like it agreed.
The clan's lucky Orm still wakes up angry at the right things.
You handled that zombie without making a speech, rare talent.
Good nose for gold, Dagna, you smell treasure through a hangover.
Dvalin sat me down, I was about to become a legend sideways at work.
Vidar's voice held the song when mine went for a walk.
S'cuse me.
That's on me.
Pardon the lean.
I spilled.
Wrong mug mine.
Didn't think.
I borrowed your helmet, Brokk, it looked lonely and also shiny.
I ate Tova's share, I thought it was applauding me.
The song went wandering, clan, I invented verses that weren't invited.
I woke Steinar for a spider that was a cloak, my bad, mostly.
I haggled like a goat, the trader didn't deserve my poetry.
I left the gate, Ragna, because I followed a very convincing moth.
Sorry, Brokk, I dripped ale on the map, the rivers are more accurate now.
Excuse me bumping the anvil, I thought it bumped me first.
I told Halvar's secret to a bench, the bench is discreet I hope.
The pickaxe in the stew pot was a short friendship, my doing.
My fault the watch was late, I was negotiating with a pillow.
I called Kolbrun a barrel with legs near the ore carts, tell her sorry.
Weak swing.
Dead weight you.
Snoozy fingers.
Bad aim.
Loud fool.
Soft beard.
Nice swing, genius, the post will write you a thank you.
Frida mines like she's asking the rock for permission every time.
He's a hero, hid in the keg when the creeper said hello.
Your gold counting is interpretive dance, Sindri, sit down.
That blade's so dull it could spread butter and still apologize.
You work like a rumor, lots of travel, no arrival.
Kolbrun's threats are adorable, like a goat in a helmet.
She trades like her pockets are haunted, and not by coins.
You call that a watch, I call that a nap with opinions.
Vidar's map is a suggestion and a cry for help in those tunnels.
Yngvar's stew has the personality of wet gravel, no offense to gravel.
Oh yes, brilliant, leave the gate open for the wildlife tour.
He's all clan talk and no coal on the fire.
Your pickaxe has better posture than you, and it's bent.
Give space.
Don't you.
Not yours.
Last chance.
Stay away.
Touch that.
Pity if your cart found the ravine tonight, Orm, just a thought.
Touch Ingrid's gold again and I remember how doors work.
Keep grinning at my axe and I'll give it a reason.
One more cheat from that goblin and I fold him into a receipt.
Come for the clan horn and you leave shorter, stranger.
Wake Orm for a joke and I will invent a new one on your nose.
Step toward the kids' bread and we stop being drinking friends.
Lie about the ore weight again, Brokk, and the scale learns teeth.
Follow me down the shaft and the dark gets personal.
Spill that stew on purpose and you wear it home.
Keep mocking Hrolf's limp and I stop being charming.
I will politely relocate your face if that mug moves again.
Rear hiss.
Duck left.
Loose rock.
Mind that.
Lava close.
Glowy slag.
Careful, the creeper's hugging the fence like it pays rent.
Watch the shaft, it coughed a pebble at my boot like a hint.
That blade's loose in the haft, it'll leave you mid boast.
Don't stand so close to the coals, Alvis, your beard has dreams.
Storm's over the farm, bring the loaves before they learn to swim.
Zombie on the west path, tell the ones still using both feet.
The trader's weights look heavier on our side, just saying, look twice.
Gate hinge is tired, it'll drop on a toe that isn't listening.
Spider eggs under the bench, I wouldn't sit heroic tonight.
Stay off that ladder, Eitri, it sways like I do.
Quiet now, something's chewing the supports that isn't us.
Hold the children, the hall's about to get a visitor with too many legs.
He's cheating.
Admit it.
That was you.
She lied.
He stole.
You saw that.
Where did the gem go, Dagna, and don't point at the stew.
Skadi left the supports looking decorative, that's why my hat drips.
You sold the clan's spare axe and called it spring cleaning.
Torvi drank the toast meant for the dead, I watched the mug travel.
The outsider touched the relics, I saw the guilty shine on his fingers.
You let the goblin count, that's how the coin learned to vanish.
Vidar started that brawl then hid behind a very brave song.
Who took my helmet, and why is it sitting on Yngvar like a confession.
You blamed the mine for your lazy swing, the mine has witnesses.
Runa hid the last sausage in a story about wolves, cute, still theft.
Grimhild, the ledger jumped and landed in your favor, explain the athletics.
He opened the gate for a breeze and invited a creeper, that's on him.
Howdy.
Met you good.
You made it.
Evenin kin.
Hallo there.
Look, it's Dvalin, I was saving a wobble just for you.
Evening, Grimhild, your books can wait, your mug cannot.
Hey, the forge crew's here, I can smell the sparks on you.
Welcome, stranger, we don't bite unless the stew is late.
There he is, Hrolf, I told the chair you'd wander in.
Hail, you lot, I have returned from a very serious nap.
Oh, Torvi, I thought you were a very upright coat rack.
Morning, I think, the forge is already judging me.
Come through, clan, the door only bit me a little.
Well met, human, your face is new and not yet annoying.
Hey Runa, I found the hall, it was hiding behind my eyelids.
Greetings from this stool, it has adopted me.
Look who remembered the way, Sindri, I almost started a search party.
Hi folks, I brought an appetite and a rumor about goats.
Take care.
Steppin sideways.
Walk safe.
Bedtime.
Till the sun.
I'm taking my feet home before they file a complaint, Dagna.
Farewell, you beautiful loud people, try not to finish the keg.
Night, Eitri, if the anvil calls, tell it I'm deceased till dawn.
Leaving the treasure where I can forget I saw it, bye.
Off to the bunk, clan, don't elect anyone funny.
Bye, axe, you were a good listener tonight.
See you after I argue with a pillow and lose, Brokk.
I'm sliding toward bed, wish the hallway honesty.
Good night, farm, keep the goats from unionizing without me.
That's my exit, stranger, try not to buy anything shiny.
Going quiet now, the song can finish without my help.
Farewell, Skadi, hide my boots so morning has to work.
Out I go, if I greet a spider, I meant to.
